name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 222 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 222 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Militants continue to target security forces in Jammu and Kashmir, with attacks on CRPF personnel in Kulgam and Kishtwar resulting in injuries to jawans and the death of two police officers, while the chief minister condemned the Kishtwar incident. In Manipur, armed clashes persist, including the killing of a Kuki woman and injuries to two others, and a separate firing that left a woman farmer dead and three men wounded in Kangpokpi district. The NIA has inspected the Kulgam attack site and intensified search operations across the region. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Militantene fortsetter å angripe sikkerhetsstyrker i Jammu og Kashmir, med angrep på CRPF-personell i Kulgam og Kishtwar som førte til skader på jawaner og døden til to politibetjenter, mens statsministeren fordømte hendelsen i Kishtwar. I Manipur vedvarer væpnede sammenstøt, blant annet drapet på en kvinne fra Kuki-samfunnet og skader på to andre, samt en separat skyting som drepte en kvinnelig bonde og såret tre menn i Kangpokpi-distriktet. NIA har inspisert angrepsstedet i Kulgam og skjerpet søkeoperasjonene i regionen. UCDP registrerte 437 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
